text.brief: On November 20, 1948, Communist authorities in Mukden sealed the American consulate general and confined Consul General Angus Ward and his staff inside.
text.record: The Party held Ward and his staff under house arrest for about a year. In October 1949 it arrested Ward on a charge of assaulting a Chinese employee, convicted him and expelled him that December. Washington protested and could do nothing else.
text.reading: The Party's first act toward American officials was detention, and it set the template for Downey, Fecteau and the Two Michaels. A hostage costs the taker little and freezes the other side's options.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The United States had no response package for detained diplomats, so each case waited for a fresh decision.
text.fix: Decide the response to a detained diplomat or citizen before it happens, and publish the price the jailer will pay.
